bull_bear.body:
- Capital position: Capital Adequacy CRAR 31.95% and Tangible Net worth of Rs 3,613 Cr as of Q1 FY27, with Leverage (Avg AUM/Avg Tangible Equity) of 3.25x versus 3.17x in Q4 FY26, 3.01x in Q1 FY26, 3.10x for FY26 and 2.81x for FY25.
- Borrowing mix for Q1 FY27 is diversified across Bank Rupee Loan 56.6%, ECB & FCNR 13.5%, NCD 7.8%, Securitisation 3.4%, Co-origination 13.5% and DFI's & FI's 5.2%, with lenders spanning public sector, private sector and foreign banks, FIs, DFIs and NCD holders at a AA- (Stable) rating.
- ALM - June 2026 shows an asset-liability Surplus in every bucket: 2,229 (upto 3 months), 3,095 (upto 6 months), 2,853 (upto 1 year), 1,162 (upto 3 years) and 2,191 (upto 5 years), all in Rs Cr.
- Management & Employees hold 6.9% of diluted share capital; promoter Clermont Group holds 52.31% (non-diluted, as on June 30, 2026).
- The deck makes no mention of dividend, buyback or a stated payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Focused Segment: 'Offering Secured MSME loan to small businesses with focus on Rs 5 lakh - Rs 30 lakh ticket size', a segment the deck sizes (CRIF data, as of Mar-26) at a Market Size of Rs 4.6 lakh cr with CAGR of 23.2% over FY18 to FY26; the total MSME market is shown as Rs 17.2 tn growing 18.7%.
- Pan-India Footprint: 'Diversified pan-India network with presence in 18 states & 2 UTs' — 256 branches, 201 Cities, and AUM mix by region of South 34.77%, East 14.52%, North 34.53%, West 16.18% on AUM of Rs 11,922 Cr; deck claims 'No concentration risk & well distributed growth'.
- Team & governance: 'Experienced, cycle-tested, professional management with strong corporate governance backed by marquee investors' — Aseem Dhru as Executive Vice Chairman, Mahesh Dayani as MD & CEO, board chaired by Neeraj Swaroop (Ex CEO - SCB, Singapore) with ex-RBI and ex-M&M Financial Services directors alongside Clermont Group nominees.
- Credit rating AA- (Stable); the journey slide records equity listing on NSE and BSE with 'India ratings upgraded us to AA-', inclusion in the MSCI Global Small Cap Index, and 'CARE, ICRA Ratings Upgraded us to AA- in Q2 FY25'.
- Underwriting as the stated moat: 'Understanding of segment with a tested credit underwriting and risk management framework', tailored to 'underserved, underbanked informal customers' with partial income proof and limited commercial credit history.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Shareholding] Non-diluted pattern as on June 30, 2026: Promoters 52.31%, Mutual Funds/AIF/Insurance/Banks 20.71%, Individuals & Bodies Corporate 13.68%, Foreign Portfolio Investors 7.22% and Foreign Companies 6.08%; named large holders are SBI Mutual Fund 8.10%, Aditya Birla Sun Life 5.14%, Amansa Capital 4.00% and Malabar Funds 3.20%.
- [ECL staging] As on June 30, 2026 (Rs Cr): Gross Loans Outstanding of 10,054 (Stage 1), 345 (Stage 2), 284 (Stage 3) and 10,683 Total; ECL Provision of 28 / 56 / 120 and 204 Total; ECL Provision % of 0.27% / 16.28% / 42.22% and 1.91% Total — Stage 2 provision cover has stepped up sharply from 5.88% at June 30, 2025.
- [Disbursement plateau] Secured MSME Disbursal Value of Rs 809 Cr in Q1 FY27 is flagged 'YoY -' (Q1 FY26 809, Q4 FY26 785) and Secured MSME Disbursal Volume of 7,700 is 'YoY -11%' (Q1 FY26 8,619, Q4 FY26 7,597) — volumes fell while value held flat.
- [Early-warning indicator] 1+ DPD % for secured MSME at AUM level has risen through the period shown: 8.12% (Q1 FY26), 8.44% (Q4 FY26) and 9.18% (Q1 FY27), even as Gross NPA improved YoY.
